title: Europe perils
text:
Europe perils

Touchstone
 includes support for various
 perils and peril codes for Europe.

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PFL | Inland flood | Inland flood peril is available, by separate license, only for exposures in: Great Britain (pre-v13.0) United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland (13.0 and later) Central Europe (including Germany, Austria, Czech Republic, and
 Switzerland, and Poland) Southeast Europe (Albania, Macedonia, and Serbia) Italy |
| PSH | Storm surge | Storm surge peril is available only for exposures in Great
 Britain. |
| PWA | All wind perils (tropical cyclone and severe storm) | Winter storm sub-peril is valid only for United States
 exposures. |
| PWH | Extratropical Cyclone only | |
| PWX | Severe Thunderstorm (wind excluding tropical cyclone) | Severe Thunderstorm is appended to PWH exposures for the 22 countries
 where Severe Thunderstorm is supported, on exposure upgrade from Touchstone 5.0. |

Peril support by country

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for each
 country within the European region:

| Country | Peril codes | Perils |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Albania | PAL PES PFL | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood |
| Austria | PAL PES PFL PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Belgium | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Bulgaria | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| Cyprus | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| Czech Republic | PAL PES PFL PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Denmark | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Estonia | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Finland | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| France | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Germany | PAL PES PFL PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood Extratropical cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Greece | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| Hungary | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Ireland (Republic) | PAL PES PFL (added in v13.0) PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland Flood (added in v13.0) Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Israel | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| Italy | PAL PES PFL (added in v11.5) | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland Flood (added in v11.5) |
| Latvia | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Liechtenstein | PAL PWH PWX | All licensed perils Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Lithuania | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Luxembourg | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Macedonia | PAL PES PFL | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood |
| Netherlands | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Norway | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Poland | PAL PES PFL PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Portugal | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| Romania | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| Serbia | PAL PES PFL | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood |
| Slovakia | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Slovenia | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Sweden | PAL PES PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Switzerland | PAL PES PFL PWH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood Extratropical Cyclone only Severe thunderstorm |
| Turkey | PAL PES | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only |
| United Kingdom | PAL PES PFL PWH PSH PWX | All licensed perils Earthquake shake only Inland flood Extratropical Cyclone only Great Britain storm surge Severe thunderstorm |
